nodes.text: India reported its first Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) case in an 8-month-old in Bengaluru on January 6. The Baptist Hospital detected it, though the state health lab didn't test the sample. DGHS Dr. Atul Goel said HMPV causes flu-like symptoms, mainly in young and elderly. https://t.co/7aR9wbAjwh

nodes.text: ICMR identifies two cases of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) in Karnataka via routine surveillance. The health ministry confirms no unusual rise in ILI or SARI cases nationwide, and neither patient has a history of international travel. https://t.co/yUqDHCqzfQ https://t.co/otNOzLneF0

nodes.text: HMPV, first identified in 2001, is less severe than COVID-19, with lower mortality and less infectiousness. Unlike COVID-19, it's not a new disease and has been a known cause of respiratory infections, especially in vulnerable groups. https://t.co/jaRDoqGwJa https://t.co/xOeO0agR1F
